signature: SUBROUTINE DTPMQRT( SIDE, TRANS, M, N, K, L, NB, V, LDV, T, LDT,

params.name: side
params.reference:
-   `= 'L'`: apply Q or $Q^T$ from the Left;
-   `= 'R'`: apply Q or $Q^T$ from the Right.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: No transpose, apply Q;
-   `= 'T'`: Transpose, apply $Q^T$.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix B. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the matrix Q.

params.name: L
params.reference: The order of the trapezoidal part of V. $K \ge L \ge 0$. See Further Details.

params.name: nb
params.reference: The block size used for the storage of T. $K \ge \mathrm{NB} \ge 1$. This must be the same value of `NB` used to generate T in CTPQRT.

params.name: V
params.reference: The i-th column must contain the vector which defines the elementary reflector H(i), for $i = 1$,2,...,k, as returned by CTPQRT in B. See Further Details.

params.name: ldv
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array V. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,M)$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDV} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: T
params.reference: The upper triangular factors of the block reflectors as returned by CTPQRT, stored as a `NB`-by-K matrix.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \mathrm{NB}$.

params.name: A
params.reference: (`LDA`,K) if `SIDE = 'R'` On entry, the K-by-N or M-by-K matrix A. On exit, A is overwritten by the corresponding block of $Q \, C$ or $Q^T \, C$ or $C \, Q$ or $C \, Q^T$. See Further Details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,K)$; If `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix B. On exit, B is overwritten by the corresponding block of $Q \, C$ or $Q^T \, C$ or $C \, Q$ or $C \, Q^T$. See Further Details.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,M)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
